# Sekar Bali Activity

> Bali adventure tours in Pejeng, Ubud — ATV rides, whitewater rafting, canyon tubing, and village cycling with hotel pickup and all-inclusive pricing.

## Overview
Sekar Bali Activity is a local Bali adventure operator based in Pejeng Village (near Ubud, Gianyar). We specialize in ATV jungle rides, whitewater rafting, canyon tubing, and Pejeng village cycling tours. Packages include gear, guides, insurance, and hotel pickup. Book directly via WhatsApp with no upfront payment required to inquire.

## Key Experiences
- **Single ATV Ride** — Solo jungle / volcanic trail ATV adventure. From IDR 650,000 / 1 pax.
- **Tandem ATV Ride** — Share an ATV with a partner. From IDR 859,000 / 2 pax.
- **Whitewater Rafting** — Class II–III canyon rafting. From IDR 400,000 / person. Lunch included.
- **Canyon Tubing** — Float through hidden canyons. From IDR 359,000 / person.
- **Village Cycling Tour** — Pejeng rice terraces & villages. Promo IDR 888,000 → IDR 650,000 with lunch or breakfast included.

## Why Book With Us
- Local Balinese guides from Pejeng / Ubud area
- All-inclusive pricing (gear, guide, insurance, hotel pickup in Ubud area)
- Suitable for beginners — safety briefing on every activity
- Fast WhatsApp booking, no payment required to inquire
- 5★ guest feedback positioning and 2,500+ guests hosted
